svg.title: Rating plate
svg.desc: A rating plate. input: model-written first drafts. output: what survived tests, benchmarks and real data. built with: Python · TypeScript · FastAPI · Next.js · React · Node. also: PostgreSQL · pgvector · PostGIS · Redis · Celery · Electron. ai: Claude Code · LangGraph · hybrid retrieval · Ollama · evals. checked by: pytest · Vitest · Playwright · mypy · Ruff · gitleaks · CI.
